title: sanger-tol/readmapping pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

specimen.description: Identifier of the specimen. Usually a BioSpecimen accession.
specimen.errorMessage: specimen must be provided and cannot contain spaces

run.errorMessage: run must be provided and cannot contain spaces
run.description: Identifier of the sequencing run. Usually the accession number of the data in INSDC.

datatype.errorMessage: Datatype must be one of: hic, illumina, pacbio, pacbio_clr, ont

datafile.errorMessage: Data file for reads cannot contain spaces and must be BAM/CRAM/FASTQ format. Note that FASTQ inputs should be interleaved if paired-end.

library.description: Library type. Set to `uli` for ULI demultiplexing with LIMA, `pimms` for PiMmS demultiplexing with LIMA, or `amplifi` for PCR-duplicate removal with pbmarkdup. For other library types, use a free-form identifier which is assigned to read group (`@RG`) ID. If not specified, the pipeline auto-creates one from the data filename.

barcode.description: Barcode identifier used to trim barcode adapter for PacBio reads. If empty, barcode-specific adapter sequences will not be trimmed.

adapter_file.errorMessage: Adapter FASTA file for ULI/PiMmS LIMA demultiplexing cannot contain spaces
adapter_file.description: Path to an adapter FASTA file. For ULI samples, overrides the global `--pacbio_uli_adapter`; for PiMmS samples, specifies the adapter sequences for LIMA demultiplexing.

adapter_preset.errorMessage: When provided, adapter_preset must be SYMMETRIC or ASYMMETRIC
adapter_preset.description: LIMA adapter preset (`SYMMETRIC` or `ASYMMETRIC`). Required for PiMmS samples. If omitted for PiMmS, the pipeline warns when no `adapter_file` is given, and errors when `adapter_file` is provided without it.
